title: IPEX Performance Test approach
content:
Purpose:

  • The purpose of this document is to provide the template and performance test guidelines for reference.
  • Projects planing for performance testing of their respective application can use this approach document to prepare their plan and minimum performance test validation needed to maintain the quality of their product.


Why Performance Testing?

  • Speed is KEY.
  • Users have less patience .
  • Multiple competitors in market so if our product is slow, user tend to switch quickly.
  • Device explosion and demand multiple user platform support. 
  • High speed internet easily available , so users expect the applications to compliment the speed of internet they are paying for.
  • Faster performing application leads to better business, quite obvious. 

Project X has very high user volume at multi-geo locations , not confident of performance and demands a performance test: 

Questions:

  • How do we start?
  • Do we have analyzed technical NFRs?
  • Business KPIs if any ?
  • Environment configurations?
  • User Load simulation?
  • Tools and reporting?
  • How to fit the test in Delivery Pipeline?

Let's Plan!!

Business Hypothesis:

  • The project should try to define the high level requirement of performance from End user perspective.

  • All the NFRs should be technically analysed.

    • User volume and throughput
    • Infrastructure related utilization matrices.

    • Failover
